sources.citation: Dal Negro A, Rossi G, Tazzoli V (1975), American Mineralogist 60:280–284
sources.inspection: All five pages read and visually inspected, all six tables including printed structure factors, both figures. Current IMA and 2024 nomenclature identify the Ce species. Table 2 has La0.56 Ce0.82 Sr0.40 Ca0.22; Ce and Sr dominate their respective charge classes. Five-grain chemistry, separate 0.2 g thermogravimetric specimen and 0.16 x 0.10 x 0.08 mm diffraction crystal are not a common quantitative experiment. Normalization uses assumed volatile allocation. Text 20:80 H2O:CO2 versus Table 1 values 6.24:22.12 is unresolved. No H atoms, independent mixed-site refinement or transformation experiment is claimed. Pmcn refinement R0.059 uses498 observed reflections; no absorption/extinction corrections.
sources.terms: Public reading via RRUFF; redistribution rights not established. Full text remains outside Git.
sources.handoff: New ancylite-ce identity-only owner; no IMA approval accession invented for renamed1987 special-procedure status.

sources.role: primary natural identity/structure and official deposits
sources.inspection: Full seven-page article, Tables1–6 and Figures1–3 read/visually inspected. Entire official CIF read, including formula, experiment, shared site and atom/displacement loops. All four checkCIF pages inspected. Five-spot microprobe mean La2O3 24.59 and Ce2O3 23.32wt% does not establish pure La. CO2/H2O calculated; suspected Al-bearing inclusions/films were not separately identified. Official type M16129 and IMA2021-090 are supported by original and authority. Geological late-carbonation inference is not a reaction experiment.
conflicts: Table1 F mean0.31wt% exceeds stated0–0.16 range; no correction inferred.
Table3 formula weight726.26 versus CIF363.13; the CIF sum formula omits H and uses proxy cations.
Paper wR2 0.1532 versus deposited all-reflection wR2 0.1551 and different weighting values; R1 0.0652/347 and coordinates agree.
Empirical calculated density4.324 versus proxy-model density3.876g/cm3 have different compositional bases; neither is measured density.
Five level-C/ten level-G checkCIF alerts, no A/B, with missing structure factors, absent hydrogen, sum/formula/Z and refinement warnings. No rerun or independent refinement claimed.
Table1 Nd2O3 mean2.49wt% and printed0.10apfu raise a normalization question; raw individual analyses not provided and no alternative empirical formula is computed here.
